leads.arxiv: 2508.19005 (arXiv API: v1 2025-08-26; title: Building Self-Evolving Agents via Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning: A Framework and Benchmark)

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Paper introduces ELL framework and the StuLife benchmark (1,284 interdependent tasks across a simulated college year) evaluating long-term memory, skill learning and proactive behavior; metrics include StuGPA, Long-Term Retention Rate and Proactive Initiative Score.

phase1_verified_types.procedural_workflow: Sec.4.3: "agents must abstract experiences into reusable skills and transfer them across evolving challenges"; Sec.5.2: AWM gives "a robust improvement, lifting StuGPA to 17.81 and Total Success to 10.12%".
